resources.string: Giving and finding blood should be safe. A few simple rules keep it that way.
Giving blood is free. Anyone who asks for money, or offers it, is breaking the rules: report them.
Go to the hospital or blood bank named in the request, never to a private place.
If you can, go with a friend or family member, and tell someone where you\'re going.
The blood bank screens every donor and every unit. Follow their advice, even if it means you can\'t donate today.
Fake requests, money, abuse or spam: use Report on the request or the person. You can also block them.
999 is Bangladesh\'s free national emergency number: police, fire service and ambulance.
How to give and get blood safely
People whose requests, offers and asks you don\'t see
Block someone from their request, their offer or their donor card. You can unblock them here.
You won\'t see their requests, offers or asks, and they can\'t offer on your requests or ask you to donate. They aren\'t told. You can unblock them in Settings.
Their offer on this request is declined too, so they no longer see your number. You won\'t see their requests, offers or asks, and they aren\'t told. You can unblock them in Settings.
LiquidLyf\'s team has suspended this account after reports. While it\'s suspended you can\'t post, offer or ask. If you think this is a mistake, write to %1$s.
New reports show here. Admin phones also get a notification.
A request that can\'t be read any more
Banning someone is done outside the app, by the project maintainer.
Dismiss this report? Nothing else changes.
Hide this request until it\'s reviewed? Donors stop seeing it.
Restore this request? It\'s open and visible again.
Cancel this request for good? Its owner gets their posting slot back.
Mark this report handled? Do the ban or other action with the admin scripts.
%1$s new. Open Moderation to act on them.
Done. It\'s in the admin log.
Blood must never be bought or sold. A request that mentions money (bKash, Nagad, taka, payment…) is marked for our team to check, and donors see a caution on it. Change the note, or post it as it is.
This request mentions money. Never pay or take money for blood. If anyone asks, report the request.
Thanks. Our team reviews every report. A request that 3 people report is hidden until it\'s checked.
